question: Do fit-only component-local suffix-Jacobian spans isolate the causally readable modes of the pruned programs better than the static L9 value-weight row spaces?

frozen_design.fit_only: Use the original 16 has/had and 8 is/was A1 fit rows only. Heldout A1 and A2 remain sealed until every component basis is frozen.
frozen_design.gradient_population: At every selected carrier position, collect the exact answer-minus-foil gradient with respect to each retained MLP output or retained raw head pre-c_proj slice.
frozen_design.basis_rule: SVD each component's stacked fit-gradient matrix and retain the minimum rank explaining at least 95% squared singular-value energy.
frozen_design.interpretation: The basis is a context-conditioned chain-rule contraction of downstream weights and local derivatives, not a causal-outcome-selected direction.

predictions.pred_a_authority_gradient_replay_capabil: Authorities, native gradient-forward replay, capability, projector geometry, coverage, finiteness and price pass.
predictions.pred_b_suffix_jacobian_modes_are_suffici: Jacobian-mode recovery is at least 0.90 of full-program recovery and donorward on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_c_suffix_jacobian_complements_are_s: Absolute complement recovery is at most 0.20 of full-program recovery on every task/panel.
predictions.pred_d_gradient_modes_are_dimensionally_: Every basis rank is below its component width and no larger than 48 for has/had or 16 for is/was.
predictions.pred_e_no_causal_fit_or_model_update: No heldout/A2 outcome selects a basis, no scalar is optimized, and no model update occurs.

decision: screen promotes suffix-Jacobian modes into the transparent tensor program; null shows full-dose nonlinear or alternate-route effects remain outside the local gradient quotient; invalid on authority, replay, capability, projection, coverage, finiteness, or price failure
